defmodule WorkerAuth do
  @moduledoc """
  Cross-service authentication module for background job workers.
  Uses HMAC-based token verification with replay protection via
  a sliding window counter mechanism.
  """

  @max_counter_drift 5
  @token_ttl_seconds 300
  @hmac_key (
    case Application.compile_env(:worker_app, :hmac_secret) do
      nil ->
        raise "Missing required configuration :worker_app, :hmac_secret. " <>
              "Refusing to start with a default/hard-coded HMAC secret."

      secret when is_binary(secret) and byte_size(secret) >= 32 ->
        secret

      _ ->
        raise "Invalid :worker_app, :hmac_secret. Must be a binary of at least 32 bytes."
    end
  )

  defstruct [:service_id, :counter, :timestamp, :payload_size]

  @doc """
  Verifies an incoming job request token from another service.
  Returns {:ok, claims} or {:error, reason}
  """
  def verify_request(token_binary, expected_service_id, local_counter) do
    with {:ok, claims} <- decode_token(token_binary),
         :ok <- verify_hmac(token_binary),
         :ok <- verify_service(claims, expected_service_id),
         :ok <- verify_timestamp(claims),
         :ok <- verify_counter(claims, local_counter) do
      {:ok, claims}
    end
  end

  defp decode_token(<<service_id::binary-size(16), counter::unsigned-integer-size(64),
                      timestamp::unsigned-integer-size(64), payload_size::unsigned-integer-size(32),
                      _rest::binary>> = _token) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      service_id: service_id,
      counter: counter,
      timestamp: timestamp,
      payload_size: payload_size
    }}
  end
  defp decode_token(_), do: {:error, :malformed_token}

  defp verify_hmac(token) when byte_size(token) > 32 do
    {message, provided_mac} = split_at(token, byte_size(token) - 32)
    computed_mac = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, message)
    if secure_compare(computed_mac, provided_mac), do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_hmac}
  end
  defp verify_hmac(_), do: {:error, :token_too_short}

  defp verify_service(%__MODULE__{service_id: sid}, expected) do
    if String.trim_trailing(sid, <<0>>) == expected, do: :ok, else: {:error, :service_mismatch}
  end

  defp verify_timestamp(%__MODULE__{timestamp: ts}) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if abs(now - ts) <= @token_ttl_seconds, do: :ok, else: {:error, :token_expired}
  end

  defp verify_counter(%__MODULE__{counter: remote_counter}, local_counter) do
    drift = compute_drift(remote_counter, local_counter)
    if drift <= @max_counter_drift, do: :ok, else: {:error, :counter_drift_exceeded}
  end

  @doc """
  Computes the absolute drift between remote and local counters.
  Uses subtraction to find the distance, handling the case where
  remote may be slightly ahead or behind.
  """
  def compute_drift(remote_counter, local_counter) do
    # Calculate distance between counters
    # Both are unsigned 64-bit values from the wire protocol
    difference = remote_counter - local_counter
    abs_unsigned(difference)
  end

  # Interpret the result as unsigned - if the subtraction wrapped,
  # the result will be a large positive number which we need to
  # convert back to the actual absolute distance
  defp abs_unsigned(val) when val > 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF do
    # Wrapped around - compute two's complement to get actual distance
    0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF - val + 1
  end
  defp abs_unsigned(val), do: val

  # Helper utilities used by verify_hmac/verify_service
  defp split_at(binary, pos) do
    <<left::binary-size(pos), right::binary>> = binary
    {left, right}
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    a_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(a)
    b_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(b)
    Enum.zip(a_bytes, b_bytes)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {x, y}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(x, y)) end)
    |> Kernel.==(0)
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false

end

defmodule JobWorker do
  use GenServer

  @initial_counter 0
  @max_payload_size 1_048_576

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    service_id = Keyword.get(opts, :service_id, "job_scheduler")
    {:ok, %{counter: @initial_counter, service_id: service_id, jobs_processed: 0}}
  end

  def handle_call({:process_job, token, job_data}, _from, state) do
    case WorkerAuth.verify_request(token, state.service_id, state.counter) do
      {:ok, claims} ->
        # Allocate buffer based on declared payload size
        buffer_size = calculate_buffer_size(claims.payload_size)
        result = execute_job(job_data, buffer_size)
        new_state = %{state | counter: claims.counter, jobs_processed: state.jobs_processed + 1}
        {:reply, {:ok, result}, new_state}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  defp calculate_buffer_size(payload_size) do
    # Add header overhead (64 bytes) to the declared payload size
    # payload_size is an unsigned 32-bit integer from the token
    header_overhead = 64
    total = payload_size + header_overhead
    # Clamp to safe range
    total |> max(0) |> min(@max_payload_size)
  end

  defp execute_job(job_data, buffer_size) when buffer_size > 0 do
    # Simulate job execution with allocated buffer
    _buffer = :binary.copy(<<0>>, buffer_size)
    {:completed, byte_size(job_data)}
  end
  defp execute_job(job_data, _buffer_size) do
    {:completed, byte_size(job_data)}
  end
end
